source_details.f1comments: THE TOTAL NUMBER OF PROVISIONAL BALLOTS COUNTED IN E1B MAY NOT EXACTLY MATCH THE TOTAL IN F1E. DATA IN E1B WAS COLLECTED VIA SURVEY OF COUNTY ELECTION OFFICIALS, AND DATA IN F1E REFULTS THE OFFICIAL REPORTED RESULTS. ADDITIONALLY, SOME PROVISIONAL BALLOTS WERE REPORTED IN THE RESULTS CATEGORY IN WHICH THEY WERE CAST. FOR EXAMPLE, IF A PROVISIONAL ABSENTEE BY MAIL BALLOT IS CAST AND COUNTED, THE COUNTY ELECTION OFFICIAL MAY CHOOSE TO REPORT THE RESULTS IN THE ABSENTEE CATEGORY RATHER THAN PROVISIONAL.

ADDITIONALLY, SOME PROVISIONAL BALLOTS WERE REPORTED IN THE RESULTS CATEGORY IN WHICH THEY WERE CAST. FOR EXAMPLE, IF A PROVISIONAL ABSENTEE BY MAIL BALLOT IS CAST AND COUNTED, THE COUNTY ELECTION OFFICIAL MAY CHOOSE TO REPORT THE RESULTS IN THE ABSENTEE CATEGORY RATHER THAN PROVISIONAL.

source_details.f1comments: THE TOTAL NUMBER OF PROVISIONAL BALLOTS COUNTED IN E1B MAY NOT EXACTLY MATCH THE TOTAL IN F1E. DATA IN E1B WAS COLLECTED VIA SURVEY OF COUNTY ELECTION OFFICIALS, AND DATA IN F1E REFULTS THE OFFICIAL REPORTED RESULTS. ADDITIONALLY, SOME PROVISIONAL BALLOTS WERE REPORTED IN THE RESULTS CATEGORY IN WHICH THEY WERE CAST. FOR EXAMPLE, IF A PROVISIONAL ABSENTEE BY MAIL BALLOT IS CAST AND COUNTED, THE COUNTY ELECTION OFFICIAL MAY CHOOSE TO REPORT THE RESULTS IN THE ABSENTEE CATEGORY RATHER THAN PROVISIONAL.

source_details.f13: POLLING PLACE, ALTERNATIVE ELECTION OFFICE, AND CENTRAL COUNT ELECTION OBSERVERS WERE A HINDERANCE TO THE ELECTION PROCESS AT MOST LOCATIONS.  THEY GENERALLY DIDN'T FOLLOW THE GUIDELINES OUTLINED IN OUR HANDOUTS, BUT OUR WORKERS WERE TOO INUDATED WITH WORK TO DO MUCH ABOUT IT.  I HAD NUMEROUS COMPLAINTS FROM ELECTION JUDGES THROUGHOUT THE DAY.  MANY GROUPS WERE SENDING THREE OBSERVERS TO EACH PRECINCT.  WE DON'T HAVE ROOM FOR ALL OF THESE PEOPLE, ALONG WITH VOTERS AND JUDGES.  I THINK THE ATMOSPHERE AT THE POLLING LOCATIONS BECAME TENSE AND UNCOMFORTABLE DUE TO THE OBERVERS AND THIS ISN'T THE ATMOSPHERE I WANT FOR VOTERS OR MY WORKERS.  I'M AFFRAID THAT I WILL BE LOOSING A LARGE NUMBER OF MY VETERAN ELECTION JUDGES DUE TO THIS ELECTION.  WE ALREADY STRUGGLE WITH STAFFING POLLING PLACES.  WE ALSO HAD AN ISSUE WITH OUR DS450 READING ABOUT 200 BALLOTS THAT WERE ORDERED AFTER THE ORIGINAL BATCH OF BALLOTS DUE TO AN UNATICIPATED INFLUX OF VOTER REGISTRATION CARDS FROM GROUPS ON THE RESERVATION.  THAT ADDED ABOUT 6 HOURS TO OUR NIGHT OF COUNTING THAT WAS UNPLANNED AND NOT BUDGET FOR.  I BELIEVE THIS WAS THE HIGHEST TURNOUT BLAINE COUNTY HAS EVER SEEN WITH 82.7% OF ABSENTEE BALLOTS RETURNED AND AN OVERALL TURNOUT OF 71% BEFORE PROVISIONALS ARE COUNTED.  ALL OF OUR PRECINCTS WERE NEARLY 60% PARTICIPATION AND OUR ALTERNATIVE SITE USAGE WAS UP AS WELL.

WE SEE AN UPTICK IN THOSE WANTING TO VOTE EARLY WITHOUT HAVING A SPECIFIC REASON. MANY JUST WANT TO HAVE TIME TO READ THE BALLOT AND RESEARCH THE CANDIDATES AND NOT HAVE TO STAND IN A BOOTH. PEOPLE EXPERIENCE ANXIETY AND THEY FEEL RUSHED WHEN IN THE VOTING BOOTH. THEY ALSO MAY ENCOUNTER A RACE OR ISSUE THAT THEY'RE NOT FAMILIAR WITH AND DON'T WANT TO MAKE A WRONG CHOICE.

source_details.f13: THE HANCOCK COUNTY BOARD OF ELECTIONS ADMINISTERED A SUCCESSFUL 2024 GENERAL ELECTION.

I KNOW THERE HAVE BEEN NUMEROUS COUNTIES IN THE STATE OF OHIO WHO HAVE LOST THEIR DIRECTOR/DEPUTY DIRECTOR OR STAFF DUE TO THE PRESSURE, HOURS, AND WORKLOAD OF RUNNING ELECTIONS.  WE ARE EXPECTED TO BE EVERYTHING FROM PAYROLL TO IT/CYBERSECURITY EXPERTS.  SMALLER COUNTIES WHO HAVE AT THE MOST 4 FULL TIME EMPLOYEES ARE CONSTANTLY STRUGGLING TO COMPLETE EVERYTHING.  WHILE WE MAY NOT HAVE TO MAINTAIN THE AMOUNT OF VOTER RECORDS AS THE LARGER COUNTIES, WE ALSO DO NOT HAVE 20+ EMPLOYEES TO WHOM ALL THE WORK IS DELEGATED.

THIS FORMAT WAS VERY CONFUSING AND COUNTER INTUITIVE. THE REFERENCE LOOKED NOTHING LIKE THE SURVEY. MULTIPLE REPORTS MUST BE GENERATED TO COMPLETE THE SURVEY AND A LOT OF THE DATA REQUESTED IS NOT IN THOSE REPORTS.

source_details.f13: ELECTION DAY WAS BUSY BUT RAN SMOOTHLY. LINES WERE NOT TERRIBLY LONG AND RARELY EXTENDED OUTSIDE THE BUILDING. WE HAD A LOT OF COLLEGE STUDENTS WHO THOUGHT THEY COULD REGISTER THE NIGHT BEFORE AND STILL COME IN AND VOTE IN PERSON. THE MAJORITY OF THOSE HAD TO VOTE BY PROVISIONAL BALLOT AND PROVIDE ID AND PROOF OF ADDRESS. IT IS THE COLLEGE AGE YOUNG ADULTS WHO SEEMED TO BE IN THE DARK ABOUT THE PROCESS.

source_details.f12comments: ALL BALLOTS WERE TALLIED IN THE CLERK'S OFFICE AT THE COURTHOUSE

source_details.f1comments: F1G IS LESS THAN C8A BECAUSE WE INCLUDED THE UOCAVA VOTERS IN THESE NUMBERS.   WE WERE ALSO OFF 2 VOTER HISTORIES.

source_details.f11b_1other: WE USED VISTA TO CHECK VOTER REGISTRATION FOR IN-PERSON VOTING AND PROVISIONAL.

source_details.f10g_other: WE DON'T USE POLL BOOKS.  WE USE OUR REGISTRATION SYSTEM AS OUR POLL BOOK.
source_details.f13: NO COMMENTS.

source_details.f11comments: WE USE PAPER AT THE POLLS FOR VOTER REGISTRATION
source_details.f13: THERE IS SO MUCH TO THIS REPORTING AND OUR PROGRAM ONLY KEEPS TRACK OF SO MUCH OF IT.  SO MUCH ALSO NEEDS TO BE SUPPLIED FROM THE STATE.  A LOT OF THESE QUESTIONS WOULD REQUIRE US TO SHEET SO MANY SPREADSHEETS THAT WOULD TAKE UP SO MUCH TIME DURING A VERY BUSY TIME IN A SHORT WINDOW.  MANY COUNTY AND STATES MAY KEEP TRACK. MY OFFICE HAS SEVERAL OTHER DUTIES OTHER THAN ELECTIONS.  HAPPY TO DO MY BEST THOUGH.

source_details.f11comments: WE USE VISTA FOR PULLING VOTER INFORMATION.  WE DO NOT CONTRACT WITH ANOTHER COMPANY FOR THIS TASK. WE USE THIS SYSTEM AT OUR VOTE CENTERS.
source_details.f13: IT WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE A SPREADSHEET OF SOME KIND WITH THE INFORMATION THAT WE ARE REQUIRED TO REPORT ON SO WE CAN COLLECT THAT INFORMATION THROUGHOUT THE TIME FRAME SO WE CAN MORE ACCURATELY ANSWER THESE QUESTIONS.

source_details.f10g_other: ENCODE CARDS FOR USE IN DRE MACHINE.
source_details.f11b_1other: ACCESS TO UTAH'S VISTA REGISTRATION SYSTEM VIA KNOWINK POLL PAD.

source_details.f12comments: BALLOTS COUNTED IN THE CLERK'S OFFICE IN THE COUNTY BUILDING -
source_details.f13: NONE

I BELIEVE THE BOXES THAT SHOULD MATCH SHOULD AUTO FILL AS YOU MOVE THROUGH AND THEN YOU KNOW WHAT HAS TO MATCH AND YOU DON'T GET THE ERROR MESSAGES.   THERE IS MUCH CONFUSION WITH THE IMPLICATIONS OF THE DATA IT IS ASKING FOR AND WHAT THE ERRORS ARE GENERATED FROM.

source_details.f2_other: INTERNAL TRACKING DATA AND CANVASS RECORDS
WE DO OUR BEST TO KEEP GOOD SPREADSHEETS
source_details.f11comments: WE DO NOT DEPLOY VRS OFF SITE. IT IS ALL DONE IN OUR OFFICE.
source_details.f13: IT WENT VERY WELL. IT WAS A DECENT TURNOUT AT NEARLY 90% AND THERE WERE NO BIG PROBLEMS - NOTHING WE COULDN'T HANDLE.
THE QUESTIONS IN THE EAVS REPORT WERE WRITTEN IN A MORE SIMPLIFIED MANNER. THE POP UP HELP SECTION WAS VALUABLE AND A TIME SAVING TOOL.

source_details.f2comments: NO COMMENT
source_details.f11comments: UTAH USES "VISTA" WHICH IS A STATEWIDE PROGRAM THAT ALL COUNTIES  SECURE ACCESS FOR VOTER INFORMATION.

source_details.f1comments: WI DOES NOT HAVE ANY PRECINCTS/JURISDICTIONS THAT ARE 100% VOTE BY MAIL.  SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.  IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.

IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.

IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.
source_details.f11comments: WI DOES NOT USE ANY TYPE OF VOTER REGISTRATION SYSTEM TO ASSIST WITH ADMINISTERING ELECTIONS AT POLLING PLACES ON ELECTION DAY.

SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.  IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.

IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.
source_details.f11comments: WI DOES NOT USE ANY TYPE OF VOTER REGISTRATION SYSTEM TO ASSIST WITH ADMINISTERING ELECTIONS AT POLLING PLACES ON ELECTION DAY.

SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.  IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.

SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.  IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.

IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.
source_details.f11comments: WI DOES NOT USE ANY TYPE OF VOTER REGISTRATION SYSTEM TO ASSIST WITH ADMINISTERING ELECTIONS AT POLLING PLACES ON ELECTION DAY.

IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.

IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.
source_details.f11comments: WI DOES NOT USE ANY TYPE OF VOTER REGISTRATION SYSTEM TO ASSIST WITH ADMINISTERING ELECTIONS AT POLLING PLACES ON ELECTION DAY.

SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.  IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.

SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.  IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.

IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.

IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.
source_details.f11comments: WI DOES NOT USE ANY TYPE OF VOTER REGISTRATION SYSTEM TO ASSIST WITH ADMINISTERING ELECTIONS AT POLLING PLACES ON ELECTION DAY.

IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.
source_details.f11comments: WI DOES NOT USE ANY TYPE OF VOTER REGISTRATION SYSTEM TO ASSIST WITH ADMINISTERING ELECTIONS AT POLLING PLACES ON ELECTION DAY.

IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.
source_details.f11comments: WI DOES NOT USE ANY TYPE OF VOTER REGISTRATION SYSTEM TO ASSIST WITH ADMINISTERING ELECTIONS AT POLLING PLACES ON ELECTION DAY.

SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.  IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.

IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.
source_details.f11comments: WI DOES NOT USE ANY TYPE OF VOTER REGISTRATION SYSTEM TO ASSIST WITH ADMINISTERING ELECTIONS AT POLLING PLACES ON ELECTION DAY.

IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.
source_details.f11comments: WI DOES NOT USE ANY TYPE OF VOTER REGISTRATION SYSTEM TO ASSIST WITH ADMINISTERING ELECTIONS AT POLLING PLACES ON ELECTION DAY.

IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.
source_details.f11comments: WI DOES NOT USE ANY TYPE OF VOTER REGISTRATION SYSTEM TO ASSIST WITH ADMINISTERING ELECTIONS AT POLLING PLACES ON ELECTION DAY.

IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.
source_details.f11comments: WI DOES NOT USE ANY TYPE OF VOTER REGISTRATION SYSTEM TO ASSIST WITH ADMINISTERING ELECTIONS AT POLLING PLACES ON ELECTION DAY.

SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.  IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.

IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.
source_details.f11comments: WI DOES NOT USE ANY TYPE OF VOTER REGISTRATION SYSTEM TO ASSIST WITH ADMINISTERING ELECTIONS AT POLLING PLACES ON ELECTION DAY.

IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.
source_details.f11comments: WI DOES NOT USE ANY TYPE OF VOTER REGISTRATION SYSTEM TO ASSIST WITH ADMINISTERING ELECTIONS AT POLLING PLACES ON ELECTION DAY.

SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.  IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.
